name: pg_sift
abstract: Exact BM25 full-text index and column-store aggregates for PostgreSQL
description: pg_sift adds a BM25 full-text index access method (sift), a column index (sift_col) and a column table access method (sift_table), and answers grouped aggregates from them as Custom Scan (SiftAgg), with one CREATE EXTENSION and no shared_preload_libraries.

pg_sift.abstract: BM25 full-text index, column index and aggregate pushdown
